lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Base plate to long flange fold, about 91 deg, outer skins 2 and 3. In sections at 5/25/50/75/95% the label sits on the outer-skin apex: outer apex is 0.00-0.04 mm off along the bisector and the nearest surface point is 0.06-0.26 mm away. The line is parallel to the fold. It runs from relief notch to relief notch; surface occupancy within 1 mm of the line matches the 150 mm extent exactly, with no overshoot into the notches.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Flange (4) to left end tab (6), about 48 deg; 4 and 6 are the convex/outer faces. All five sections put the dot on the outer apex arc (offset 0.01-0.05 mm, nearest point at most 0.11 mm). In the face-on close-ups the line spans the full tab width, from the relief notch to the free edge; the arc extends only about 1 mm past each label end.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Flange (4) to right end tab (7), about 49 deg, outer skins 4 and 7. All five sections put the dot on the outer apex (offset 0.01-0.06 mm, nearest point at most 0.19 mm). It is parallel to the fold and covers the full tab width from the relief notch to the free edge, so the extent is correct.
